title: The Big Five Explained
excerpt: Lion, leopard, elephant, buffalo and rhino: why these five are called the Big Five and where to see them in Tanzania.
body:
## Where the name comes from

The term "Big Five" originally came from hunters, describing the five animals considered most dangerous to hunt on foot. Today it is a safari bucket list.

## The five

- **[Lion](/blog/lion-facts/)**: Serengeti, Ngorongoro, Ruaha.
- **[Leopard](/blog/leopard-facts/)**: Seronera, Tarangire.
- **[Elephant](/blog/elephant-facts/)**: Tarangire, everywhere.
- **[Buffalo](/blog/buffalo-facts/)**: almost all parks.
- **[Rhino](/blog/rhino-facts/)**: Ngorongoro Crater.

## Chances

On a northern circuit safari including Ngorongoro, the chances of seeing all five are good, but never guaranteed. Leopards and rhinos are the hardest.

## Beyond the Big Five

Cheetahs, giraffes, wild dogs and many birds are just as special.

Read our [Big Five page](/big-five-destination-tanzania/) or [plan your safari](/travel-proposal/).
